title: Moreish Puff Manju Man Mango Strawberry 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Moreish Puff Manju Man Mango Strawberry blends the smooth, golden sweetness of ripe Mango with the bright, juicy flavour of fresh Strawberries. The tropical mango base provides a rich and velvety inhale, while the strawberry adds a layer of soft berry sweetness, bringing a refreshing contrast that lingers on the exhale. Blended at 70VG/30PG, this high-VG shortfill is designed for sub-ohm vape kits, delivering thick vapour and bold, well-rounded flavour. Supplied in a 100ml shortfill bottle, it leaves space for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing vapers to customise their preferred nicotine strength. Part of the Manju Man series by Moreish Puff, this flavour is crafted for vapers who enjoy layered, fruit-forward blends with a smooth, satisfying finish.
